spearman_family: Spearman family: 6 existing Brier contrasts (sigmoid and isotonic minus baseline, for logistic regression, random forest, and RBF SVM) crossed with 6 characteristics. 36 two-sided permutation tests. Holm is applied inside this family only. The dataset is the unit (n=8).
split_families: Two Holm families, adjusted separately. Cross-dataset: the 64 pre-specified Nadeau-Bengio tests (logistic isotonic Brier, logistic isotonic ROC-AUC, logistic sigmoid Brier, forest sigmoid Brier; sigma 0 and 1; eight datasets). WDBC: the 48 Brier and 10-bin ECE tests (sigmoid and isotonic minus baseline; three models; four sigmas).
